income_tax.note: No individual income tax of any kind.

senior_tax_credits.note: N/A -- no income tax to give a break against.

effective_rate_pct.unit: % of home value/year, statewide avg effective rate
effective_rate_pct.note: TX has no income tax, so relies heavily on property tax.

new_buyer_effective_rate_pct.label: New buyer / recent purchase
new_buyer_effective_rate_pct.unit: % of purchase price/year, typical effective rate before the 10% homestead appraisal cap has had time to create a gap
new_buyer_effective_rate_pct.note: TX's homestead cap resets to market value at sale (unlike CA/FL), and at 10%/year is far more generous than CA's 2% or FL's 3%, so it mainly creates a gap during rapid-appreciation years (e.g. 2021-2022) rather than steadily every year -- the gap between this figure and the statewide-average figure above is smaller than for CA/FL/OR. The 1.40% above is Tax Foundation's CY2023 Census-based statewide average; more recent (2026) guides cite ~1.6% statewide. Not applied to the computed estimate below, which uses the statewide-average figure.

general_homestead_reduction_usd.unit: $ off assessed value for school-district taxes, all homestead owners

senior_homestead_reduction_usd.unit: $ additional off assessed value for school-district taxes, age 65+ (on top of the general exemption)
senior_homestead_reduction_usd.note: Combined general + over-65 exemption applies specifically to the school-district portion of the levy. City/county/other taxing units may offer smaller, separate local-option exemptions not modeled here. Exact combined totals were in flux after the 2023 and Nov 2025 relief packages -- verify against your county appraisal district before relying on the exact dollar figure.

property_tax.relief_programs_note: School Tax Ceiling ('senior freeze'): once a homeowner turns 65 (or becomes disabled) and claims the exemption, their school-district tax bill is frozen at that year's dollar amount and cannot increase in later years even as home values rise (can decrease if rates drop) -- not modeled numerically here, but a meaningful long-run benefit beyond the assessed-value reduction applied above.
